summary_zh: Ruflo 是面向 Claude Code 与 Codex 的智能体执行框架：用一条 npx ruflo init 命令为项目加入智能体、钩子、记忆和 MCP 服务器，可部署多智能体集群、协调自主工作流，并具备自适应记忆、联邦通信与向量 RAG 等能力，让多个智能体协同完成任务。
audience_zh: 适合使用 Claude Code 或 Codex 等 MCP 客户端、希望为项目加入多智能体协同与持久记忆的开发者；也适合想先通过插件轻量试用、再决定是否做完整项目安装的用户。

evidence.quote: 🌊 The original agent harness. Deploy intelligent multi-player swarms, coordinate autonomous workflows, and build conversational AI systems. Features adaptive memory, self-learning intelligence, federation, vector RAG integration, and native Claude Code / Codex / Hermes and many more Integrated
**An agent meta-harness for Claude Code and Codex.**

`init` adds ruflo's agents, hooks, memory and MCP server to the project, and Claude Code picks them up on its next start. Codex and other MCP clients work too: point them at `npx -y ruflo@latest mcp start`.
